question: Do fixed literature-named epithelial RNA features distinguish alveolar and secretory-airway reference states in the qualified Strunz repair cohort?
decision: Narrow interpretation of developmental reuse; mixed directions retain broad plasticity, while supported reference-state associations motivate a later destination-specific question without fate attribution.
strongest_rival: Cross-sectional author states, time support, depth and cell selection reflect identity/composition rather than future lineage destination or developmental function.
discriminator: Within-mouse ADI-minus-activated-AT2 features, plus AT1-minus-ADI and Club-minus-ADI on identical three-state support; preserve absence of eligible basal mice.
exposure_record: Original Guo/Strunz outcomes, state labels, raw support and Dong/Liu literature are known. Exact 12 genes and comparisons set before new gene-level aggregation. Exposed exploration; no independent validation.
biological_unit: Original deposited mouse (sample_id), with cells nested in each source-labelled state.
nesting_and_overlap: Each source sample is one mouse per original qualified methods; states paired within mouse. Sampling days contain different mice. Reference-state contrasts share mice; no independent replication across contrasts.
population_and_selection: Original day2-21 injured, non-NC mouse epithelium. Raw UMI>=500, >=30 cells/state; >=3 supported mice. Primary uses paired ADI/activatedAT2; destination references use common AT1/Club/ADI support.
contrast: Equal-mouse paired expected detection differences (case minus reference) for the three exact named contrasts; no subtraction across different-support contrasts.
endpoint: Each of 12 fixed genes: cell-mean expected detection after sampling500 raw UMI, mouse paired difference in percentage points.
methods: Exact without-replacement detection expectation, per-mouse aggregation, pointwise descriptive t intervals, equal-day and per-day summaries; exact integer-combination and scalar-aggregation verification. Full specification and features bound as code.
missingness_and_exclusions: Original NC exclusion, day/depth/cell floors retained. No imputation or alias rescue. Missing gene or invalid matrix/join stops. Basal below floor is held, not pooled.
multiplicity: Report all12 genes and three prespecified contrasts; no p-values or selected-significance claim. Intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous.
precision_basis: Observed between-mouse paired dispersion for the selected sampling schedule only; no meaningful-effect margin or power claim.
interpretation_limit: Named-feature RNA associations are neither lineage destination nor successful repair, HIF activity or causal KLF regulation. The Guo module and held independent GSE303646 replication are unchanged.
stop_rule: Fail on hashes, barcode/unit/count integrity, missing named feature or arithmetic error. Hold unsupported states/contrasts at original floors. No outcome-driven feature or floor change.
amendment_reason: Owner-authorized literature-informed target screen, separately scoped from existing frozen results; no prior design is overwritten.
